content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for DCI Recruitment 2026 depends on the position. Trainee Marine Engineer and Trainee Electrical Officer posts require relevant engineering qualifications, while NCV Trainee requires 10th pass and approved pre-sea GP Rating training. Fleet Personnel applicants must possess the prescribed maritime competency certificates or relevant professional experience. Candidates must have completed a four-year Degree in Marine Engineering from an IMU-affiliated, DG Shipping-approved or otherwise recognized institute as specified in the notification. Alternatively, candidates who have completed Graduate Marine Engineering from a recognized university after a four-year engineering degree may apply. Candidates who have already acquired or are about to obtain an MEO Class IV Certificate of Competency are not eligible for the Trainee Marine Engineer position. Candidates must have completed a four-year engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Electrical Engineering Electronics Engineering Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Telecommunication / Communication Engineering Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Applicants must also have completed the four-month Electro Technical Officer (ETO) course from a DG Shipping-approved institution. The notification additionally refers to completion of basic STCW courses. NCV Trainee applicants must have passed SSC / 10th Class from a recognized education board, completed an approved pre-sea GP Rating course and passed the DG Shipping-approved Exit Examination with at least 60% aggregate marks. Candidates must carefully check the exact competency alternatives and minimum experience requirements in the official notification.

rows.required_certificate_experience: Master (FG), Dredge Master Grade-I or Master (NCV) competency/certification as prescribed.
First Mate (FG), Dredge Master Grade-II or Mate (NCV) competency certificate.
Second Mate (FG), NWKO-NCV or Dredge Mate Grade-I, with prescribed independent watchkeeping experience on dredgers.
Prescribed MEO Class-I, Dredge Engineer Grade-I or alternative engineering competency certificate with applicable experience.
Prescribed MEO Class-II, Dredge Engineer Grade-II or alternative marine engineering competency with applicable experience.
Specified Indian Navy survey/navigation background, NWKO-NCV, Dredge Mate Grade-II or GPR with prescribed dredger tube-operator experience.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Trainee Stipend 2026 – Monthly Payment and Allowances
content_sections.text: DCI offers a monthly stipend of ₹25,000 to Trainee Marine Engineers and Trainee Electrical Officers, plus ₹600 per day as victualing allowance. NCV Trainees receive ₹10,000 per month plus ₹405 per day as victualing allowance during training. The notified training stipend is ₹25,000 per month plus ₹600 per day as victualing allowance. This is a training stipend and should not be confused with the salary payable after completion of training. Trainee Electrical Officers receive ₹25,000 per month plus ₹600 per day as victualing allowance during the training period. NCV Trainees receive ₹10,000 per month plus ₹405 per day as victualing allowance during training.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Trainee Training Period and Service Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Yes. Selected Trainee Marine Engineers and Trainee Electrical Officers must provide a bank guarantee of ₹3 lakh or deposit the equivalent amount with DCI. This is linked to a five-year service commitment after the required training and the applicable competency certification or posting conditions. The notification does not prescribe this ₹3 lakh bond condition for NCV Trainees. Training periods may be extended or curtailed according to DCI or DG Shipping requirements.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DCI Recruitment 2026 selection varies between Fleet Personnel and Trainee posts. Fleet Personnel are assessed through an interview, while Trainee Marine Engineers and Trainee Electrical Officers are assessed using qualification marks and interview performance. NCV Trainee selection is based on academic and GP Rating Exit Examination marks. Fleet Personnel candidates will be selected based on interview performance. The minimum qualifying score is 50 marks out of 100. For General and OBC candidates, the minimum required marks are 40 out of 80 in the qualification component and 10 out of 20 in the interview. For SC and ST candidates, the minimum required marks are 36 out of 80 in the qualification component and 9 out of 20 in the interview. NCV Trainee selection is based on the prescribed qualification marks, with 50% weightage for SSC / 10th Class marks and 50% weightage for GP Rating Exit Examination marks.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 Application Form – Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates do not need to apply online for DCI Recruitment 2026. They must complete the prescribed bio-data or trainee application form and attend the relevant walk-in interview with original certificates and self-attested copies. Fleet Personnel interviews are scheduled for 5 November 2026, while trainee interviews are scheduled for 6 November 2026. DCI Application Form 2026: Visit Official Careers Page to Download the Prescribed Form Important: No online application is required. Candidates should report according to their post category and interview location. 10th / SSC certificate for date-of-birth proof Relevant educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Engineering degree / provisional degree certificate, where applicable Relevant DG Shipping-approved ETO or maritime training certificate Valid Indian Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) Valid Indian Passport INDOS details Basic STCW 2010 course certificates Prescribed Certificate of Competency, where applicable Relevant experience certificates Community certificate for reserved-category candidates, where applicable OBC self-declaration, where applicable CGPA / SGPA conversion certificate, where applicable Completed prescribed application / bio-data form One set of self-attested photocopies of applicable supporting documents Candidates must bring the documents required for their specific post. Failure to produce the necessary original certificates and copies during verification may result in exclusion from the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DCI has notified 28 trainee vacancies, including 14 Trainee Marine Engineer, 10 Trainee Electrical Officer and 4 NCV Trainee posts. Additional Fleet Personnel positions are advertised without a specified vacancy count.

faq.question: Q2. What is the DCI Recruitment 2026 walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The Fleet Personnel walk-in interview is scheduled for 5 November 2026. Trainee Marine Engineer, Trainee Electrical Officer and NCV Trainee interviews are scheduled for 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is online application required for DCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview with the prescribed application form and required certificates. The advertisement explicitly states that online application is not required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a DCI Trainee Marine Engineer?
faq.answer: The trainee stipend is ₹25,000 per month plus ₹600 per day as victualing allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the DCI Trainee Electrical Officer stipend?
faq.answer: The notified stipend is ₹25,000 per month plus ₹600 per day as victualing allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the DCI NCV Trainee stipend?
faq.answer: NCV Trainees receive ₹10,000 per month plus ₹405 per day as victualing allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for DCI Trainee Marine Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must have the prescribed four-year Marine Engineering Degree or recognized Graduate Marine Engineering qualification after a four-year engineering degree.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for DCI NCV Trainee?
faq.answer: NCV Trainee candidates must be below 25 years of age on the date of joining on board.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written examination for DCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not prescribe a common written recruitment examination. Fleet Personnel are selected through interview, Trainee Marine Engineers and Trainee Electrical Officers through qualification marks and interview, and NCV Trainees through prescribed academic and GP Rating Exit Examination marks.

faq.question: Q10. Is DCI Recruitment 2026 a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement states that vacancies are temporary and contractual in nature and do not create an entitlement to permanent employment with Dredging Corporation of India Limited.
